{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
trial_df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Drop duplicate patient_id rows, keeping the highest sample_seq
trial_df = trial_df.sort_values('sample_seq', ascending=False).drop_duplicates(subset='patient_id', keep='first')

# Check the distribution of severity across arms
severity_arm_cross = pd.crosstab(trial_df['severity'], trial_df['arm'])
print(severity_arm_cross)

# Check the response rate by sex, unadjusted
response_by_sex = trial_df.groupby('sex')['responded'].mean()
print('\nResponse rate by sex (unadjusted):')
print(response_by_sex)

# Check the distribution of severity by sex
severity_sex_cross = pd.crosstab(trial_df['severity'], trial_df['sex'])
print('\nSeverity by sex:')
print(severity_sex_cross)"}
